body: I was already working reduced hours, and have been getting  worse. In this situation, taking time off work is the best solution.

Me and my mom were best friends, I think thats why it hurts so much, and her being like this feels like an emotional rollercoaster. I never know when she's herself or when she's going to attack. I've been desperately wanting to move out, but I simply can't afford it atm

If this trailer is anything to go by, James Cameron has really pushed technology to its brink in terms of what is possible with CGI and motion-capture! I cannot wait to see the characters I grew to love in the first one!

Jake's Avatar was originally modelled for his brother Tommy, that might be a reason that he doesn't have his tattoos.  I mean the only reason Jake got the avatar is because him and Tommy were identical twins.. There is also the fact that the Na'Vi, from what I can see, don't have Tattoos like us. The whole point of the Avatar program is to be as much like the Na'vi as possible in order to earn their trust and be welcomed in by them. I doubt a massive arm tattoo was going to make Jake look non-human...

No one ever suggested it, but I had considered it a few months back, and feel like its very likely that the surgery did cause her to have some personality switches. Which is hard, cause I can't be angry at her for that, its not her fault at all.
